name: Zom Strike 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Zom Strike is a thrilling first-person shooter game where you must survive relentless waves of zombie enemies, or "Zoms." Scavenge the battlefield for resources, upgrade your arsenal of guns, and use strategy to stay ahead in the fight. With intense action and weapon progression, every battle is a test of survival against the undead horde!
